body: This isn't actually a bug, using uppercase values seems to not be allowed by Jib either: https://github.com/GoogleContainerTools/jib/blob/master/jib-core/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/tools/jib/api/ImageReference.java#L64

@geoand Without setting the container-image.group my windows username is used instead per default, which is uppercase too and causes the same error.

So shouldn't be an automatic toLowercase inside the code?
Yeah, if it takes the username by default, we certainly need to lowercase it if uppercase is not allowed.
OK yeah, I see your point
